title: Access-Reject sent (generic 'Login incorrect')
plain_english: The server processed the request and deliberately rejected it. 'Login incorrect' is FreeRADIUS's summary line — the actual reason is in the module output just above it in the debug log. If no more specific signature was matched above, the reject likely comes from a policy or a module this analyzer doesn't have a rule for yet.

causes.cause: A module in the authenticate/authorize chain returned reject — the parenthesised text after 'Login incorrect' names it.
causes.next_check: Read the text in parentheses on the 'Login incorrect' line and the ~20 debug lines before it; that names the module and the exact check that failed.

causes.cause: An explicit reject in your policy (unlang) — e.g. a group check or NAS filter.
causes.next_check: Search the debug output for 'reject' inside the policy sections (post-auth, authorize) to see which condition fired.
